decisions.reason: Operation Master campaign details exploit chain for CVE-2026-0257 with AdaptixC2 deployment; real active exploitation, primary reporting from GBHackers.

CVE-2026-0257.evidence: GBHackers describes active exploitation by Operation Master combining GlobalProtect VPN exploitation with AdaptixC2 deployment across enterprise networks; Rapid7 previously confirmed two attack waves.

decisions.reason: Renewed ShinyHunters attacks against Oracle PeopleSoft CVE-2026-35273 using encoded request path to bypass WAF rules; Mandiant/GTIG confirm targeting of 100+ organizations.

CVE-2026-35273.evidence: ShinyHunters deployed JSP web shells and ran commands via Java deserialization against PeopleSoft; Mandiant and GTIG confirm attacks spanning higher education, technology, healthcare and government.

decisions.reason: Primary reporting on fake Jev API proxy sites (jev-ai.pro, jevtypesafeai.com) charging 6-11.5x official rates; three-day-old clone operation with real financial impact.

CVE-2026-88771.evidence: Citrix advisory confirms exploitation in the wild; unauth remote code execution affecting all NetScaler ADC/Gateway deployments including default config.

CVE-2026-88772.evidence: Confirmed exploitation; memory overflow exploitable for RCE or DoS on appliances with DTLS (default on VPN virtual servers).
